title: Integer group determinants for the elementary abelian group of order 49
summary: Let $G=C_7\times C_7$, and let $S(G)$ denote the set of integer values of its group determinant. We determine $S(G)$ by classifying the values divisible by $7$; the coprime values are already known. Every nonzero divisible value has valuation at least $10$, and every multiple of $7^{12}$ occurs. At valuations $10$ and $11$, we give necessary and sufficient conditions on the cofactor in terms of two additive invariants of ideals in $\mathbb{Z}[ζ_7]$.
